svg.title: Software Engineering — Definition and Evolution Mind Map
svg.desc: Mind map covering the definition of software engineering, its three key properties, the engineering approach, and the four eras of its evolution including the software crisis.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me a full note on the definition and evolution of software engineering')
sendPrompt('What is the formal definition of software engineering?')
sendPrompt('What does systematic mean in software engineering?')
sendPrompt('What does disciplined mean in software engineering?')
sendPrompt('What does cost-effective mean in software engineering?')
sendPrompt('Why is software engineering not just about coding?')
g.text: Not coding — it is a complete approach

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the engineering approach in software engineering?')
sendPrompt('Explain the branded vs non-branded analogy for software engineering')
sendPrompt('What is the build and fix method and why is it bad?')
sendPrompt('Explain the full evolution of software engineering across all eras')
sendPrompt('Explain the origin era of software engineering 1945 to 1965')
sendPrompt('What was the software crisis and what caused it?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about IBM OS/360 as an example of the software crisis')
sendPrompt('What were the failure statistics during the software crisis era?')
sendPrompt('How did the internet era change software engineering post 1990?')
sendPrompt('Explain the mobile and AI eras of software engineering')
sendPrompt('What are the key outcomes of software engineering evolution?')
sendPrompt('Does following the engineering approach guarantee success?')
sendPrompt('How did open source software change software engineering?')
